description: Read-only; changes nothing. Where an approval request (submit_activity with `approval`) stands: pending, approved (with the history row it produced), rejected (with the reason, if the person gave one), expired, cancelled, stale (the entry or the module changed since it was sent; send a new one if the user still wants it) or failed. Call it when the user asks; do not poll in a loop.

requestId.description: The requestId submit_activity returned for an approval request

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: get_approval_request
title: Get Approval Request
